h: Soludo approves ₦50,000 December bonus for Anambra civil servants
p: Anambra Governor Charles Soludo has approved a one-off ₦50,000 payment for all state civil servants, to be paid with December salaries. He announced it at the state's Civil Service Day celebration.
body: Anambra State Governor Charles Soludo has approved a one-off payment of ₦50,000 for all civil servants in the state, to be added to their December 2026 salaries.

Soludo announced the bonus at the 2026 Civil Service Day celebration at the Jerome Udoji State Secretariat in Awka on Friday, 20 November. He also gave on-the-spot orders to improve working conditions at the secretariat.
Workers had raised concerns about how Anambra's pay compares with other states, and the governor reportedly responded to those comparisons during the event.
The announcement comes in a busy week for Soludo, whose party, APGA, has adopted President Bola Tinubu as its candidate for the 2027 election.
more: It will be paid with December salaries.
It was announced at Civil Service Day in Awka.
